A first guide to the living colony.
category.infestusfrontier.contact.name: First Contact
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.the_wakin: This guide covers the starting ingredients and how the colony grows only where you choose. Each page names what you need first. Nothing here is required to play. Read a page when you want to know what to do next.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.a_culture: Craft Spore Culture from rotten flesh, a red mushroom and wheat seeds. Use it on exposed ground to start the colony. Craft a copy of this book from a book and one Spore Culture if you lose it.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_su: Living Substrate grows from basic to young to mature. It changes only the cells you select. It never spreads on its own, so the colony stays where you put it.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.organ_bud: A blank that becomes an organ
An Organ Bud is the blank an organ grows from. Craft it, or grow it in a Culture Bowl, then craft an organ from it. It stands on Living Substrate and waits.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.digestive: Feed the Sac by hand or by hopper. Rotten flesh gives 50 BU in 8 seconds. Wheat gives 100 BU in 2 seconds. An empty bucket takes 1000 BU. Feeding by hand earns First Biomass; a hopper-fed batch credits nobody.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.biomass_b: The Bladder stores up to 4000 BU. Pour a bucket of biomass in to store it, or take a bucket back out. Direct connections also move biomass.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.culture_b: The Bowl grows cultures in 60-second batches. Spore Culture takes a red mushroom, wheat seeds and 100 mB of water. An Organ Bud takes Spore Culture, two rotten flesh and bone meal. Load the ingredients by hand, then press Start on its screen.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.speak_to_: Read an organ without opening it

Craft a Synaptic Probe from a bone, a slime ball and Spore Culture. Use it on an organ to read its biomass without opening the screen. Any other item, or an empty hand, opens the screen: what the organ is doing, what it holds, and the buttons that start work. Sneak to build against an organ.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.roo: The colony begins with a single culture.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.liv: Use a Spore Culture on exposed ground.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.org: Craft or grow an Organ Bud, a blank that becomes an organ.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.dig: Digest a batch in a Digestive Sac for your first fuel; a full Sac pauses instead of spilling.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.bio: Pour a bucket of biomass into a Biomass Bladder to store it.
